name: ca.sophialabs/nomos
title: SophiaLabs Nomos (Apache 2.0) - Git Worktree & 42-Gate AST Harness for Coding Agents
description: SophiaLabs Go CLI & MCP: GitHub repo AST X-Ray, 42 coding-agent DoD gates, worktree & CI guards.

tools.name: search_nomos_corpus
tools.description: Search Nomos Engineering Handbook chapters, Empirical Field Dispatches, Open-Core Architecture Specs, and CLI reference by keyword. Example: query='worktree isolation', section='handbook' finds chapters on Git worktrees. Use when looking up conceptual architecture, empirical benchmarks, or CLI flags. Do NOT use when inspecting a specific G-* gate or ERR_* code (use inspect_dod_gates or diagnose_nomos_error instead) or comparing external tools (use compare_governance_approaches instead).

query.description: Keywords or engineering problem phrase to search across the public Nomos corpus.

tools.name: inspect_dod_gates
tools.description: List and filter the 42 compiled Go and Tree-sitter AST Definition of Done quality gates, 7 Canonical Laws, and sandbox rules. Example: gate_id='G-16' or law=7 returns matching gate invariants. Use when browsing gate invariants by G-* ID, Law 1..7, or category. Do NOT use when troubleshooting a raw verify error log or ERR_* failure (use diagnose_nomos_error instead).

gate_id.description: Optional gate identifier such as G-01 or G-16.

law.description: Optional Canonical Law number from 1 through 7.

tools.name: recommend_adoption_plan
tools.description: Retrieve a read-only 4-step Nomos rollout guide (X-Ray baseline, stealth Branch Guard, CI SARIF, and isolated Git worktrees) tailored to repository LOC, languages, and air-gap constraints. Example: languages=['go','typescript'], repo_loc=120000 returns a phased brownfield guide. Use when planning rollout steps for a team or monorepo. Do NOT use when previewing raw nomos.yaml and CI workflow templates (use scaffold_nomos_config instead).

languages.description: Primary programming languages in the repository.

airgapped.description: Set true for zero-egress air-gapped local GPU environments.

tools.name: compare_governance_approaches
tools.description: Compare Nomos deterministically against pre-commit hooks, SonarQube, ESLint, PR review bots (CodeRabbit, Greptile), prompt wrappers, and static CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md / .cursorrules files. Example: focus='SonarQube' returns side-by-side trade-offs. Use when evaluating tool trade-offs or answering 'how is Nomos different from X'. Do NOT use when searching general Handbook tutorials (use search_nomos_corpus instead).

focus.description: Optional comparison dimension or tool name filter.

tools.name: xray_github_repo
tools.description: Inspect a public GitHub repository, pull request ratchet delta (pr), head-to-head rival shootout (vs), file path (focus), or organization rollup (org) via read-only static Tree-sitter AST analysis (<= 100MB source archive). Example: repo='go-chi/chi' (or repo='go-chi/chi', pr=42, or org='go-chi') returns the AST scorecard and Day-0 baseline preview. Use when auditing a public GitHub repo, PR, comparison, or org URL. Do NOT use when checking private repositories (private codebases require local CLI inspection via @mgantlett/nomos).

repo.description: Public GitHub owner/repo slug or full https://github.com/<owner>/<repo> URL.

pr.description: Optional pull request number for a base-vs-head AST ratchet delta.

vs.description: Optional second public owner/repo slug for a side-by-side structural shootout.

focus.description: Optional file or directory path within the repository to spotlight.

org.description: Optional GitHub organization or user handle when requesting an org-level rollup.

tools.name: diagnose_nomos_error
tools.description: Look up any Nomos ERR_* failure code, TC-AGT-* vector, or nomos verify gate rejection to retrieve its root cause and non-bypassing AST remediation. Example: error_code='ERR_CROSS_PLANE_MUTATION' returns the remediation guide. Use when troubleshooting a verify failure or pre-commit hook error. Do NOT use when browsing the full catalog of 42 gates by Law or category without an error (use inspect_dod_gates instead).

error_code.description: Optional ERR_* identifier such as ERR_CROSS_PLANE_MUTATION or ERR_COGNITIVE_DEBT.

error_log.description: Optional raw error message, gate name, or pre-commit output snippet.

tools.name: scaffold_nomos_config
tools.description: Preview read-only nomos.yaml configuration text, 4-line GitHub Actions SARIF workflow text, and Day-0 onboarding commands without modifying files. Example: project_name='payments-api', mode='local' returns template text. Use when retrieving ready-to-paste YAML config and CI workflow templates. Do NOT use when requesting a strategic rollout recommendation by LOC or air-gap posture (use recommend_adoption_plan instead).

mode.description: Onboarding mode: branch (default), local (stealth .git/info/exclude), or worktrees.

ci_provider.description: CI platform for verification workflow output (defaults to github).
